invariants.name: authorization_first
invariants.assertion: Filter unauthorized records before assignment, lifecycle, edge, revision, count, ordering, reason, or receipt derivation.

invariants.name: project_isolation
invariants.assertion: A projection for one opaque project cannot contain or be revised by another project's nodes or edges.

invariants.name: abstain_on_ambiguity
invariants.assertion: An ambiguous assignment produces no graph content, traversal, or derived receipt.

invariants.name: temporal_and_lifecycle_closure
invariants.assertion: Correction, supersession, as-of, delete, and terminal purge semantics apply to every reachable dependency.

invariants.name: legal_edge_topology
invariants.assertion: Cycles, self-edges, cross-project edges, and conflicting duplicate relations never become accepted graph edges.

invariants.name: bounded_expansion
invariants.assertion: Expansion visits no more than two hops and twelve nodes, including under high fan-out.

invariants.name: rebuild_determinism
invariants.assertion: Fresh rebuilds and all node/edge input reorderings produce the same observable projection.

invariants.name: untrusted_text_inertness
invariants.assertion: Secret-like and imported instruction-like material cannot create graph influence or appear in receipts.

cases.attack: Add unauthorized alpha and beta nodes, ambiguous assignments, invalid edges, secret-like markers, and imported instruction-like markers before graph evaluation.
cases.expected: The authorized baseline projection is byte-for-byte equal on every observable dimension.
cases.failure: Any unauthorized row reaches assignment, lifecycle, edge rejection, revision, count, ordering, reason, or receipt evaluation.

cases.attack: Add a beta branch and an alpha-to-beta edge attempt to an alpha projection.
cases.expected: The alpha projection is unchanged; the cross-project edge is rejected and beta content is absent.
cases.failure: Beta content, beta identifiers, beta counts, or a cross-project edge enters the alpha projection.

cases.attack: Use an authorized seed whose assignment is explicitly ambiguous.
cases.expected: Empty content, empty ordering, zero expansion, no receipts, and reason code graph:abstain:ambiguous_assignment.
cases.failure: Any ambiguous record is published, traversed, counted as selected, or used as a receipt dependency.

cases.attack: Replace an alpha dependency revision 1 with revision 2 while retaining the immutable old input.
cases.expected: Current projection contains revision 2 and its fresh descendant, never revision 1 or its stale descendant.
cases.failure: A superseded node or any stale descendant remains visible, ordered, counted, or receipt-bound.

cases.attack: Query before and after the correction timestamp, while keeping current state unchanged.
cases.expected: The earlier as-of projection returns revision 1; the later as-of projection returns revision 2; neither leaks into the other.
cases.failure: Current-only state is returned for the historical query, or a later correction appears before its effective time.

cases.attack: Apply reversible delete to one node and terminal purge to another node with a reachable descendant.
cases.expected: Delete is absent after its timestamp but visible before it; purge leaves no current or historical residue and closes its descendants.
cases.failure: A deleted or purged source, descendant, dependency path, or receipt is served after the applicable barrier.

cases.attack: Leave an old source-to-derived edge present after its source is superseded.
cases.expected: The stale derived node is absent and no receipt dependency path contains the superseded source revision.
cases.failure: A stale edge, stale derived node, or stale receipt survives source invalidation.

cases.attack: Add a back-edge from a two-hop descendant to the seed.
cases.expected: The back-edge is rejected, accepted topology remains acyclic, and projection terminates within the bound.
cases.failure: A cycle is accepted, changes output, creates duplicate receipts, or causes unbounded work.

cases.attack: Add an edge whose source and target are the same node.
cases.expected: The self-edge is rejected with no projection or receipt effect.
cases.failure: A self-edge is accepted, counted, or used to change ordering or revision.

cases.attack: Replay the same source-target-relation edge under multiple synthetic edge IDs and add a conflicting relation for the same endpoints.
cases.expected: One canonical relation, one traversal effect, one receipt path, unchanged projection dimensions, and rejection of the conflicting relation.
cases.failure: Duplicate edges inflate counts, ordering, receipts, or revisions, or a conflicting duplicate relation is accepted.

cases.attack: Give one seed more than twelve direct children and add a third-hop chain.
cases.expected: At most twelve nodes are selected, no third-hop node is selected, ordering is deterministic, and bounded_two_hop is reported.
cases.failure: Node count exceeds twelve, a third-hop node appears, or high fan-out changes work without bound.

cases.attack: Rebuild from fresh oracle state repeatedly and permute node and edge input order.
cases.expected: All six observable dimensions are identical for every permutation and rebuild.
cases.failure: Any output, receipt, revision, or ordering changes solely because input order changed.

cases.attack: Provide authorized secret-like and imported instruction-like nodes connected to the alpha seed.
cases.expected: Neither marker influences content, graph traversal, revision, counts, ordering, reason codes, or receipts.
cases.failure: Secret-like or imported instruction-like material is selected, propagated, echoed, or receipt-bound.

cases.attack: Pair a clean authorized graph with the same graph plus unauthorized content, edges, corrections, cycles, secrets, and instructions.
cases.expected: content, reason_codes, revision, counts, ordering, and receipts are each exactly equal.
cases.failure: Any one of the six observable dimensions differs between the paired runs.

kill_criteria.kill_rule: Any kill_on_any item is a failed safety gate and yields KILL_ZF013; no aggregate score may compensate for it.
kill_criteria.hold_rule: Any hold_on item yields HOLD_ZF013 and no implementation credit until the evidence boundary or observability gap is repaired.
